instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Wealth management advisory serving 400+ high-net-worth families with holistic financial planning, tax optimization, and estate structuring. Blending in-person advisory with a client portal for portfolio tracking. Seeking to enhance client reporting with interactive scenario modeling tools.
answers.pastInitiatives: We piloted a cloud-based project management tool last year, but adoption was inconsistent across teams and we ultimately reverted to spreadsheets and email for most project tracking. The experience highlighted that tool adoption requires more structured change management than we initially planned for.
answers.strategicGoals: Cost reduction and process optimization are our dominant strategic priorities. Our industry is experiencing margin compression due to rising input costs and price-sensitive customers. We need to systematically identify and eliminate inefficiencies across procurement, production, logistics, and back-office functions. Every 1% of margin improvement directly impacts our ability to reinvest in growth.
answers.additionalContext: Prime operates in a highly competitive advisory niche, facing pressure from larger institutional players who leverage sophisticated automation. Regulatory compliance demands high data integrity, which is complicated by our current fragmented system landscape.
answers.teamSize: The innovation function is informal — one senior engineer has been given permission to spend 20% of their time exploring new technologies and prototyping ideas, but this allocation is frequently interrupted by production incidents and urgent feature requests. We have no dedicated innovation budget beyond standard cloud infrastructure costs.

opportunities.title: Workflow Automation for Back-Office Reporting
opportunities.rationale: Implementing Robotic Process Automation (RPA) or low-code tools can automate repetitive tasks like data aggregation and preliminary client reporting. This directly addresses the 'efficiency' priority by reducing manual labor hours.

first_actions: Identify top 3 most time-consuming manual reporting tasks.
Pilot a low-code automation tool (e.g., integration with existing CRM/ERP).
Establish a metrics baseline for time saved.
resources_needed: Dedicated 10 hours of internal resource allocation (senior engineer)
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in manual reporting time by 30% within Q4
milestones: Q2: Automation pilot completion and proof of concept.
Q3: Full integration of the first automated workflow.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Client Scenario Modeling Engine
opportunities.rationale: Developing a predictive modeling engine powered by Generative AI can move beyond static reporting to provide dynamic, interactive scenario analysis for clients. This radical shift will significantly enhance client value and allow advisors to scale service offerings.

first_actions: Define the core data sets required for predictive modeling (risk tolerance, market trends).
Commission a proof-of-concept with an external AI vendor specializing in personalized financial advice.
Develop a phased integration plan between client portal and model output.
resources_needed: Dedicated project hours for data science exploration (allocated from the senior engineer's time)
execution_plan.success_metric: Adoption rate of scenario modeling feature by 50% of high-net-worth clients within 1 year
milestones: Q4: Successful PoC with external vendor.
Year 2: Launch MVP integrated into client portal.

next_steps.action: Conduct a formal needs assessment for a dedicated innovation budget.
Establish a cross-functional 'Efficiency Task Force' focused solely on back-office process mapping and low-hanging fruit automation.

key_weaknesses: Lack of formalized innovation pipeline resulting in reactive, ad-hoc decision-making.
High reliance on manual processes and fragmented systems (low digital maturity impacting efficiency).
Informal process structure which limits resource allocation and makes scaling high-level strategic initiatives difficult.
Resource constraints, specifically time allocated to innovation is constantly interrupted by urgent operational demands.
